test_keep_alive_argument: test the pybind11 keep_alive policy on method arguments to prevent child objects from being prematurely released
test_keep_alive_return_value: test the pybind11 keep_alive policy on return values to ensure returned child objects stay alive with the parent
test_alive_gc: test garbage collection behavior with keep_alive policy and circular references using ParentGC objects
test_keep_alive_constructor: test the pybind11 keep_alive policy on constructors to ensure child arguments persist with the parent instance
test_call_guard: test the pybind11 call_guard policy to verify GIL locking and unlocking behavior in C++ bindings
